proof_review: Apply strict positivity to each packet for weights and zero-mass case; sum masses for normalization. In the orthant, nonnegative entries summing to I force zero off-diagonals, then idempotence forces disjoint zero/one diagonal entries.

proof_review: Terminal risk is fibrewise summation. Equal report probabilities and coarse posteriors give identical action backups by induction.
